messages:
sasha: Heads up — rolling the ingest heartbeat change at 10:30 PT to migrate SLA-based watermarking. Expect a short warmup that may add ~3-6% extra events for ~10m. tagging eng-platform + billing ops :eyes:
anjali: Can you paste the event shape? worried about double-counting in invoice preview if it looks like a meter event
mike: Also need a canary plan. console preview will freak out if we don't filter it out from invoice pipeline
sasha: Event will be a lightweight heartbeat type, not tokenized. Plan: POST to /v2/metering/ingest with {"event_type":"heartbeat","proxy":"edge-3","seq":12345,"tenant_id":"t-...","route_id":"r-...","dedupe_key":"hb:edge-3:12345","cost_tag":"internal_heartbeat"}. We will set cost_tag so tallyer can opt-out for invoices
anjali: hmm mixing into /metering worries me. Why not /telemetry so we separate concerns?
sasha: We chose metering to keep attribution (tenant/route) intact for quota signals. But the tallyer will skip events with cost_tag=internal_heartbeat for invoice runs. That keeps quotas informed but prevents billing impact
mike: ok but we need to ensure every downstream consumer respects cost_tag. invoice-preview, ledger-builder, and the console sampler must all honor it
oliver: also ensure quota checks still see these (so autoscale/tenant-throttle unaffected). I think is_heartbeat bool + cost_tag solves it
anjali: can we add a 1% canary first? pick 10 tenants to start with
sasha: Yes — rollout plan: canary flag hb_canary with tenant whitelist (1%). We'll emit an extra metric ingest.heartbeat.rate tagged hb_canary=true to monitor
deploy-bot: sasha/heartbeat-ingest-migration deployed to canary (edge cluster) — 2026-03-21T10:31Z :rocket:
billing-bot: ALERT: ingest edge-3 rate +4.3% vs baseline over 5m window — possible heartbeat warmup
sasha: saw the canary spike ~2% in telemetry, CPU unchanged. No duplicate dedupe_key observed so far
mike: please confirm dedupe window semantics. If dedupe is per-minute but the canary replays in backfill, invoices could accidentally include them
sasha: tallyer will ignore events with cost_tag=internal_heartbeat at invoice aggregation, dedupe still applies across all events to prevent backfill double-counts. We'll add unit tests to the ledger builder and a pre-aggregation filter in the invoice pipeline
anjali: need a UI flag in preview to hide internal heartbeats by default. customers seeing a random spike in invoice preview is bad UX
oliver: I'll add a preview filter that removes events with cost_tag=internal_heartbeat and shows a small informational banner "internal heartbeat events suppressed"
mike: also add a dashboard card for ingest.heartbeat.rate and an alert if dedupe_key collisions > 0 (that would indicate replay)
sasha: agreed. Plan checklist: 1) canary whitelist + deploy 2) metric emit + dashboard card 3) invoice pipeline prefilter by cost_tag 4) ledger unit tests + backfill script 5) runbook update
anjali: what's the backfill plan? we need reconciliation if some heartbeats slipped into past aggregates
sasha: backfill script: scripts/hb-reconcile --from=2026-03-21T09:00Z --to=2026-03-21T11:00Z. It tags any invoice rows containing dedupe_key hb:* and flags them for manual review (safe mode). We'll run it after canary stabilizes
mike: make sure replay protection is robust: example dedupe_key format in code block so ops can grep logs:
```json
{"dedupe_key":"hb:edge-3:12345","event_type":"heartbeat","tenant_id":"t-abc"}
```
oliver: also confirm: route resolution must still attach tenant_id for quota. Do not set route_id to 'system' alone or tenants will lose quota accounting
sasha: correct — route_id remains the normal route; handler will set is_heartbeat=true and cost_tag=internal_heartbeat. ledger/quotas will see the heartbeat for quota math but invoice generator will drop it
deploy-bot: canary health check passed for heartbeat-ingest-migration — 2026-03-21T10:35Z
sasha: canary steady at +1.8% ingest rate, dedupe collisions = 0, invoice-preview shows no added cost — proceeding to 5% traffic in 30m if no regressions
mike: after 5% ramp, schedule a 1h observation window before full rollout. also: add migration toggle in internal API so we can flip off canary quickly
anjali: please open an eng-platform ticket with rollout notes + console change request. billing ops wants a short summary for on-call
sasha: Will do. I'll open ticket ENG-5478 and add runbook steps + links to dashboard. Also adding a telemetry tag "heartbeat_migration:2026-03-21" for traceability
oliver: If anything odd shows in invoice-run, reach out and don't auto-approve backfill patches. manual review required
sasha: noted. I'll post a follow-up in this thread after the 5% ramp. Thanks all :thumbsup:
